## Summary

Describe the change in a sentence or two.

## Type of change

- [ ] New or updated site rule
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

## Site-rule contributions

- [ ] Hostnames are listed in `rules/sites.json` (use `*.` for subdomains)
- [ ] `removeSelectors` targets the paywall, not the article
- [ ] `keepSelectors` protects the article container, if needed
- [ ] I tested the rule against a real article on this site

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] I reloaded the unpacked extension and verified the behavior in the browser
- [ ] I updated `README.md` if the change affects usage or contributing
